verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Unreal's scripting surfaces (Blueprint, C++, Python) and generic IDE compilation via Visual Studio/XCode, but nowhere mentions an official language server (LSP) or typed API/stub definitions purpose-built for editor tooling or coding-agent attachment (e.g., no mention of Python .pyi stub generation, Blueprint LSP, or C++ compile-commands/clangd support). Community citations focus on usability/performance complaints, not tooling for AI agents.
